summary.tldr: Creates a national framework on grocery pricing and unit price displays, and requires a report on the consultations used to build it.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Industry to work with provincial governments to develop a national framework on grocery pricing and unit price display practices.
Requires the framework to include national standards for unit pricing on food and other household goods, including the accuracy, usability and accessibility of unit price displays.
Requires the framework to include ways to teach consumers across Canada about unit pricing and how it is used.
Requires the Minister to report to Parliament on the consultation results within 18 months after the act comes into force, and to publish the report online.
